preamble: The voiceless uvular fricative [χ] is replaced by the voiceless velar stop [k], combining fortition (fricative to stop) with fronting from uvular to velar place. The clear case is Dolgan, a Turkic language that grew out of Sakha (Yakut) speech adopted by Evenki and other groups in the Taimyr–Anabar region and lacks the Sakha uvulars: Sakha χ appears as Dolgan k.

examples.note: Wikipedia cites this pair for Dolgan's loss of the Sakha uvulars x and ҕ (Sakha initial s- also corresponds to Dolgan h-).
Word-final χ ~ k, as in Sakha ajmaχ ~ Dolgan ajmak 'relative' and elbeχ ~ elbek 'many'.

sources: Grenoble, L. A., Imeeva-Kysylbaikova, M., Malysheva, N., Timofeeva, A., & Vinokurova, A. (2024). Dynamics of Multilingualism in an Arctic Language Ecology. Journal of Language Contact, 17(1), 246–280. https://doi.org/10.1163/19552629-01701007
